tools.name: search_stations
tools.description: Search live radio stations in the OndaCast catalogue by name, with optional country, genre and language filters. Returns up to `limit` stations with an OndaCast page link for listening. It is for finding a station to listen to or play: each result links to the station's OndaCast page. Only stations that play in a web browser over a secure connection are listed. Country, genre and language use the English names shown in OndaCast's filters.

country.description: Country, in English (for example Brazil) or as a two-letter code (BR).

query.description: Station name or words to search for.

tools.name: get_station
tools.description: Get one radio station from OndaCast by slug or OndaCast page address: description, location, genres, language, frequency, the song playing now and the show on air when known, and the OndaCast page for listening. Stations that cannot play in a browser are not available. It is for listening to or playing a station: the answer links to the station's OndaCast page.

station.description: A station slug, or an address such as https://ondacast.com/station/{slug}.

tools.name: search_podcasts
tools.description: Search podcasts in the OndaCast catalogue by title or topic, with an optional language filter. Returns up to `limit` shows with an OndaCast page link. When OndaCast has no match, it may list shows from a public podcast directory that are not on OndaCast yet; the add_podcast tool can add one.

language.description: Language, as shown in OndaCast's filters.

query.description: Podcast title or words to search for.

tools.name: add_podcast
tools.description: Add a podcast from a public podcast directory to OndaCast, by the directoryId that search_podcasts returned in notOnOndaCastYet. This creates the show's OndaCast page and is the only tool that changes anything. It takes no web address: only directory ids such as itunes-123 or pi-456. Additions are limited per client and per day.

directoryId.description: The directory id from search_podcasts, such as itunes-123456 or pi-789.

tools.name: get_podcast
tools.description: Get one podcast from OndaCast by slug or OndaCast page address: author, description, language, category, its latest episodes with OndaCast page links, and the show's OndaCast page.

podcast.description: A podcast slug, or an address such as https://ondacast.com/podcast/{slug}.

tools.name: search_audiobooks
tools.description: Search the public-domain audiobooks in the OndaCast catalogue by title or topic, with an optional language filter. Returns up to `limit` audiobooks with an OndaCast page link.

language.description: Language, as shown in OndaCast's filters.

query.description: Audiobook title or words to search for.

tools.name: get_charts
tools.description: Get OndaCast's live song or artist chart, counted from what stations played, for the last 24 hours or 7 days, worldwide or for one country. Returns ranked entries with plays and OndaCast page links.

country.description: A two-letter country code such as US; omit for the worldwide chart.

tools.name: radio_guide_now
tools.description: List radio shows on air right now in OndaCast's radio guide, with their hosts, when they end in the show's own time zone, and the stations that carry them, each with an OndaCast page link. Optional country and genre filters.

country.description: A two-letter country code such as US.

tools.name: catalog_facts
tools.description: Get verifiable facts about OndaCast: what it offers and how large the catalogue is, as figures rounded down and refreshed weekly, with links to its main pages.
